svg.title: Beyond the sliders
svg.desc: Six curves use the original lengths 245, 140, and 65. Columns have fourteen, thirty, and sixty folds. The top row starts at zero phase, giving finer and finer petals; the bottom row turns the backward arm near the radial shoulder, giving overlapping rings. All six use one scale. These are numerical drawings at rounded phase choices, not new finite-event certificates. Chord and vertex errors stay below 0.005 sheet units. The link below opens the analytic three-visit approach.
svg.text: The original three lengths. More folds, finer threads. Numerical drawings.

a.text: Three visits approach the shoulder: follow the analytic calculation ↗
